items.html: Also the matter of this Gevura is hinted at in the Idra of Naso, page 132, side A: "And from this beard everything that is in the Rosh is known, from the thousand worlds sealed with the pure ring that includes all rings," etc. The explanation of this statement we shall explain at length below, and there you will understand that the beard of AA spread from the concealed brain of AA, within which the Gevura of Atik is hidden.
